## Relationships

### [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/harrison--john-henry-carter.md)

[Harrison](../character/harrison.md) acts as the employer of young John Henry Carter starting in Volume 2. Their working dynamic is established within the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) community context. During a severe storm that damages the town, [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) suffers the personal loss of his parrot while John Henry is in his employ.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P6](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0006), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P24](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0024), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P25](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0025), +2 more_
